review.imagery: 28 gallery entries include 6 dated construction photographs. All eighteen official primary assets, the complete 28-page brochure index, six native resources and all six September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. One exact primary repeat and one visually repeated banner crop are excluded. Six original brochure scenes add the project-branded lobby, wardrobe, home kitchen and garden. The official project page and brochure reuse interior concepts also seen in Sunset Bay Grand marketing. Those primary interior scenes are explicitly labelled shared-design concepts. They are not represented as photographs of a completed home. The distinct complete street building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All nine complete physical drawing pages 2–10 were visually reviewed on three contacts. The single freely displayed broker 1 BR image was viewed at native size. Two additional layouts are behind a form and were left unretrieved. Original margins, room boundaries, level grouping, podium uses, colour legends and rooftop labels remain intact. No printed category range was assigned to this unnumbered image. Nine complete building sheets cover ground, both podiums, residential levels through floor 8 and the rooftop amenities. One separately attributed broker image adds a 1 BR preview. These drawings state no numerical individual saleable areas. Confirm the selected home, area and final revision with Imtiaz. Additional broker layouts require a form and remain unretrieved.
review.location: Complete original brochure pages 6–7 were rendered at 3200 pixels. Page 7 regional map was visually reviewed. Its proximity headline has no numerical schedule. The current official named-place embed supplies camera-centre values without explicit target coordinates. No invented pin or numerical journey card was added.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and byte/hash receipts. Branded brochure and building-plan mirrors retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly attribution. Open broker plan-image URLs were observed in public figures. Source bytes, complete drawing sheets and notices are preserved. Original completed text research and protected identities remain intact.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, numbered-unit matching for the public preview, detailed developer home sheets, two form-gated broker layouts, exact visitor entrance, numerical original-source travel estimates, current certified site completion and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
